Actress Rashmika Mandanna's Dedication Praised by Choreographer Brinda Master

Choreographer Brinda Master expressed admiration for actress Rashmika Mandanna's dedication on the sets of the film 'Maayasa'. Master shared an emotional post on social media, highlighting Mandanna's commitment. The post focused on Mandanna's performance and work ethic during the film's production.
